text: ShortsOS has completed a real end-to-end workflow that goes from source video and render, through human review, to a live Instagram Reel with a captured publication permalink. The review comes after production and before publication, and it is a checkpoint a person has to clear, not a default that can be skipped. In that run, publication went through one Instagram account bound to the ShortsOS operator, not through an account a customer linked. For a brand, that means a person looks at the short before your audience does.
